title: Universaarl Company Information setup decision and guarded value fit
goal: Prepare and, if the gate is clear, set the first Company Information values for Universaarl GmbH in UNIVERSAARL-DE with before/after screenshots.
mustCheckBeforeRun: Role Center header or equivalent shell context shows UNIVERSAARL-DE
Company Information / Firmendaten opens under company=UNIVERSAARL-DE
Exact value set for Universaarl GmbH is documented before entry
Before screenshot exists before any setup value is changed
successCriteria: Company Information values are either saved with before/after proof or the run stops before changing values.
No posting, preview posting, document creation or master data creation occurs.
The result clearly states which fields were set and which remain open.
The next Foundation setup step is derived from the observed state, not guessed.
nextSafeAction: Run a guarded Company Information setup case with explicit before/after evidence.

smartDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-010 proved playthru with company=UNIVERSAARL-DE, visible Role Center company header and Company Information/Firmendaten page read-only. My Settings was captured as user context but not accepted as sole active-company proof.
smartDecisionCard.reason: Company Information is the first setup page after a no-data company creation and must be handled before number series, posting groups, VAT, dimensions or master data.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: The page and company context are proven read-only.
Foundation readiness follows Company Information values.
Number series and posting groups require a stable Company Information baseline.
Dimensions should follow the first foundation setup decision.
Master data planning can continue, but data creation waits for setup gates.

smartDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It is the smallest useful setup step after company creation and avoids entering later setup or master data into an unverified company state.
risksBeforeNextCase: Saving Firmendaten is a setup change and needs explicit before/after evidence.
My Settings may show a personal/default Mandant and must not be used as the only active-company proof.
requiredPreparation: Use TARGET-010 screenshots as context proof.
Prepare the exact Universaarl GmbH field values before editing.
Capture before screenshot and field values before any save.
